parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Pitt Meadows · South Bonson and Fraser Way
South Meadows is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Pitt Meadows doesn’t publish a boundary for it.

The City uses the name “South Bonson” for parts of the south end of Bonson Road: its South Bonson Community Centre is at 10932 Barnston View Road, and its Athletic Park page puts the park beside the arena “in the South Bonson area”.

My working description, from those addresses only and not an official boundary: the part of Bonson Road south of Hammond Road and the CP rail line, down to the Fraser River, with Fraser Way and Barnston View Road. My
Mid Meadows guide
covers the schools and fields further north on Bonson Road.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 18, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Pitt Meadows and School District 42.
General information only.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for South Meadows

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

The City adopted its Official Community Plan, “I See Pitt Meadows 2040”, on September 27, 2022. Goal 2 is a community where agriculture is the dominant land use and farmland is protected for food production. Goal 5 is a walkable and compact community with a range of housing options.
I found no separate neighbourhood plan for South Bonson or South Meadows on the City pages I read.

The Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District covers 3,546 hectares (3,136 in Pitt Meadows). The City says the urban development area is drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie), served by ditches, culverts and storm sewers, and that low-lying catchments drain to the Pitt, Alouette and Fraser Rivers through floodboxes and pump stations.
The City says it is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes, which protect the City’s low-lying areas and key infrastructure from river flooding.
The City says Pitt Meadows is at risk of flooding annually in May and June.
The City’s Financial Plan 2026–2030 says over 85% of Pitt Meadows’ land base lies within the floodplains of the Fraser, Pitt and Alouette rivers.
The City’s Financial Plan 2026–2030 says agriculture remains the predominant land use in Pitt Meadows and that 78% of Pitt Meadows land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve.
The built-up part of the south end is urban; I found no City statement on how much of this MLS area is ALR.
The City says Pitt Meadows has one West Coast Express station, Pitt Meadows Station, in the urban core. It is on Harris Road, which is in my Central Meadows guide area, not in South Meadows.
Route 595 (Langley Centre / Maple Meadows Station) does not enter Pitt Meadows: it runs between Langley Centre and Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge.
For a specific lot, send me the address and I’ll look up the zone and the plan designation.

blocks.text: Before you buy in South Meadows

parts.t: Check the flood and drainage rules for the lot.
Ask the City what the dikes, drainage and floodplain mapping mean for the exact address, especially for a basement or an addition.
Check what the plan allows nearby.
Ask the City what the Official Community Plan designations allow on the lots around the home, because new buildings can change a street.
Confirm the school catchment.
Ask SD42 for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Get a full home inspection.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Check the ALR on any larger lot.
Look up the address on the Agricultural Land Commission map before you plan anything on farmland.

FAQ
Where is South Meadows?
South Meadows is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Pitt Meadows doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City’s South Bonson Community Centre is at 10932 Barnston View Road, and the City puts the Athletic Park beside the arena in the South Bonson area.
How do I get around from South Meadows?

Route 722 (Bonson / Meadowtown) is a loop that uses Harris Road, Ford Road, 190A Street, Hammond Road, Blakely Road, 116B Avenue and Bonson Road to reach Fraser Way and the Barnston View roundabout. Pitt Meadows Station is one of its stops.
Route 719 (Fraser Way / Meadowtown) continues from the 722 and uses Fraser Way, Bonson Road, Wildwood and Hammond Road before it reaches Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge.
Timetable dates: routes 722 and 719, effective September 7, 2026 (read from TransLink’s timetable PDFs on October 18, 2026). Check the current timetable.
The City says Pitt Meadows has one West Coast Express station, Pitt Meadows Station, in the urban core. It is on Harris Road, which is in my Central Meadows guide area, not in South Meadows.
Which schools are near South Meadows?

I found no school on the Province’s SD42 list with a South Bonson address. Edith McDermott Elementary is at 12178 Bonson Road, Davie Jones Elementary is at 12030 Blakely Road and Pitt Meadows Elementary is at 11941 Harris Road, all Kindergarten to 7.

Pitt Meadows Secondary (Grades 8 to 12, 19438 116B Avenue) is the only public secondary school in Pitt Meadows on the Province’s SD42 list. The Province says a new school on the same property is expected to open for students by fall 2029.

What parks and recreation are there?

The South Bonson Community Centre and Pitt Meadows Art Gallery are at 10932 Barnston View Road, Shoreline Park is at 51 Bonson Road, Bonson Park is at 11546 Bonson Road, and the Athletic Park and Arena are at 11431 and 11435 Bonson Road.
The Pitt Meadows Public Library is at 200 – 12099 Harris Road, in the civic centre near City Hall and the Family Recreation Centre. I found no other library branch in Pitt Meadows.

The City adopted its Official Community Plan, “I See Pitt Meadows 2040”, on September 27, 2022. Goal 2 is a community where agriculture is the dominant land use and farmland is protected for food production. Goal 5 is a walkable and compact community with a range of housing options.
